maintenanceScheduled.title: Scheduled maintenance on {start}
maintenanceScheduled.body: Polaris will be under maintenance from {start} to {end} ({duration}). Affected: {affected}. Save your work before it starts.

maintenanceInProgress.title: Maintenance in progress
maintenanceInProgress.body: Maintenance is under way until {end}. Affected: {affected}. Some things may not work until it ends.

maintenanceFinished.title: Maintenance finished
maintenanceFinished.body: Maintenance is over and everything is back. Thanks for your patience.

updateAvailable.title: An update is coming
updateAvailable.body: A new version of Polaris will be installed on {start}. It may be unavailable for a few minutes.

updateApplied.title: Polaris was updated
updateApplied.body: A new version of Polaris is installed. Reload any open tabs to get it.

newFeature.title: Something new in Polaris
newFeature.body: There is a new feature to try. Have a look and tell us what you think.

incident.title: Service degraded
incident.body: We are seeing problems with {affected}. We are working on it and will post an update here.

policyChange.title: Our policies are changing
policyChange.body: The rules for using this instance change on {start}. Please read what is new.

admin.title: Announcements
admin.description: Tell people on this instance about maintenance, updates and anything else, on the bell, as a banner, or both.

compose.bodyHint: Supports **bold**, *italic*, `code`, [links](https://example.com) and - bullets. '{start}', '{end}', '{duration}' and '{affected}' are filled in for each reader.
compose.linkHint: A path in Polaris such as /drive, or an https address.
compose.reaches: {count, plural, =0 {Reaches nobody yet} one {Reaches # person} other {Reaches # people}}
compose.sendNoticeHint: On the bell, and by mail or other channels where people set them up. Critical ones always reach the bell.
compose.showBannerHint: At the top of every screen while it is active.
compose.noEnd: Leave empty to keep it up until you end it.
compose.leadHours: {count, plural, =0 {Only when it starts} one {# hour before} other {# hours before}}
compose.notifySteps: Also notify when it starts and when it ends
compose.previewHint: Each reader sees the dates in their own language and time zone.
compose.translated: Translated for each reader while you leave the text as it is.
compose.edited: Edited text is shown as you wrote it, in every language.

errors.delivery: Choose a notification, a banner, or both.
errors.window: Set when maintenance starts and ends.
errors.order: The end has to be after the start.
errors.link: Use a path in Polaris or an https address.
errors.title: Add a title.
errors.rateLimited: Too many sends in the last hour. Try again in {minutes} min.
errors.notEditable: It has already started, so it can no longer be edited. End it or send a new one.
errors.failed: That did not work. Try again.

history.title: Sent and scheduled
history.emptyHint: Announcements you send or schedule are listed here.
history.retractBody: It comes off every banner and its notification is removed from every bell.
